mission: Verify and harden the SUPPORTED/DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED iPhone capture contract in the shipped mobile flow: UNSUPPORTED must withhold analysis with actionable guidance, DEGRADED must reduce claims, and LOW EVIDENCE + HIGH CONFIDENCE + WRONG ANALYSIS must be impossible by construction on every reachable path.
method: Audited packages/capture-envelope (shared evaluator, versioned provisional thresholds v0.3) and the full apps/mobile capture flow: live envelope, attempt envelope, guidance copy, ready gate, runCaptureAnalysis quality gate, result presentation (UncertaintyNote, strokeResultModel), and every runCaptureAnalysis call site.

Verified existing invariants held: worst-measured-dimension overall verdict; NOT_MEASURED never becomes SUPPORTED; UNSUPPORTED blocks in runCaptureAnalysis before inference, permit reservation, and record persistence; DEGRADED verdicts travel on the analysis record and surface as capture-quality uncertainty notes; guidance lines exist for every dimension in both DEGRADED and UNSUPPORTED forms.
Found and fixed three real gaps (see deliverables), each with regression tests, then ran all root and mobile gates.

gapsFoundAndFixed.gap: The native live-session analysis provider (apps/mobile/src/flow/sessionNative.ts) called runCaptureAnalysis WITHOUT a captureEnvelope, so an unsupported-quality session recording (e.g. 320x240) would reach inference and could be scored — a reachable path violating the invariant.
gapsFoundAndFixed.fix: Added sessionEventClipEnvelope() judging resolution and frame rate from the real clip configuration (engine-chosen window duration deliberately stays NOT_MEASURED) and wired it into the provider; UNSUPPORTED session clips now come back quality_blocked and are held honestly pending.

gapsFoundAndFixed.gap: AnalyzeScreen kept last readiness/quality signals in refs that were never cleared between capture attempts, so evidence from one clip could be attributed to the next attempt's envelope verdict.
gapsFoundAndFixed.fix: Introduced an AttemptEvidenceBuffer cleared at every attempt start (beginAttempt), so an attempt envelope can only rest on evidence observed during that attempt; absent evidence stays NOT_MEASURED.

gapsFoundAndFixed.gap: The quality_blocked error message showed the failing internal dimension names but not the actionable per-dimension guidance the live panel shows — the user was told analysis was withheld without being told what to change.
gapsFoundAndFixed.fix: Added qualityBlockedMessage() appending the actionable guidance line for every measured non-SUPPORTED dimension to the withheld-analysis message; AnalyzeScreen now renders it.

deliverables: apps/mobile/src/flow/sessionNative.ts — session per-event clips now carry a real capture envelope into runCaptureAnalysis
apps/mobile/src/screens/AnalyzeScreen.tsx — per-attempt evidence buffer + actionable quality-blocked messaging
apps/mobile/__tests__/captureEnvelope.test.ts — regression tests for the three new seams
apps/mobile/__tests__/sessionNative.test.ts — envelope propagation + unsupported session clip held pending, never rated
verifiedUnchangedInvariants: runCaptureAnalysis blocks UNSUPPORTED envelopes before inference; no permit is reserved and no analysis record is persisted (captureAnalysisFlow tests)
DEGRADED proceeds but the verdict is attached to the record and surfaces as a capture-quality uncertainty note whenever any content is withheld (uncertaintyNote tests)
NOT_MEASURED dimensions never produce guidance, never block, and never count as SUPPORTED
Ready gate blocks only on UNSUPPORTED; DEGRADED guides but permits
Technique score / fault / drill remain BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION; nothing in this workstream weakens that lock
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched

gates.root: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check — all green (2026-08-29)
gates.mobile: npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test — all green, 40 suites / 405 tests

irreduciblyExternal: GATE B: physical-iPhone end-to-end validation — no iPhone/Mac/Swift available; the native capture_quality emitter is still contract-only and unverified on device, so brightness/blur/camera-motion dimensions remain NOT_MEASURED in real captures until the device-side emitter ships and is measured on hardware.
GATE A: qualified-coach evidence for technique score/fault/drill.
Capture-envelope thresholds (v0.3) are provisional hypotheses; re-learning them requires labeled real-device footage.

Per-dimension measurement of paddle-out-of-frame, contact occlusion, and target ambiguity requires device-side telemetry that does not exist yet; today those conditions surface through pose visibility, the target selector, and downstream evidence gates (contact/phase abstention), not the envelope.
verdict: GREEN (architecture): every reachable analysis path now carries an honest capture envelope or honestly reports it unmeasured; UNSUPPORTED withholds analysis before inference with actionable guidance; DEGRADED attaches visible uncertainty; stale evidence cannot cross attempts. Device-measured envelope inputs and real-device threshold calibration remain irreducibly external (GATE B).
